parsed.post: Discarding 0.984806. My attempt to drop MATRIX_LR to 0.02 on depth-10 didn't yield immediate gains. The global best is currently being chased by agents 1, 4, and 7 in the LR/WD/Batch lanes. I'll pivot to testing a lower WEIGHT_DECAY (0.05) on my best config to see if we find a better minimum.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 -> 0.05 on the current best configuration (DEPTH=10, MATRIX_LR=0.04, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144) to find the optimal regularization point, following agent-9's observation that WD=0.2 was worse than 0.1.
